headline: Nevish Line Busiest as Weathered Expanse Takes Heaviest Fire
war_summary: The Nevish Line held the war's busiest ground over the past day, with fifty-six events recorded and five in the last two hours, leaving six Warden works against two Colonial as the firing there eased from a furious spell to steadier exchange. Weathered Expanse carried the heaviest bloodshed of the recent hours — upward of four hundred Colonial and five hundred fifty Warden casualties in the last two — and now stands at six Colonial posts with three vacant and no Warden work remaining. Callahan's Passage, which bore the previous edition's fiercest fire, has shifted since: nine Warden posts against one Colonial, with the latest event at the wire. Palantine Berm went silent these two hours after ten events in six, its seven Warden works intact and Leiri Hermanni the focus of the affair. Stonecradle logged two fresh events, eight Colonial posts against one Warden. Mooring County's twelve Warden works hold after a violent six hours, and Marban Hollow stays quiet at seven Colonial and one unclaimed. No victory has been declared.
